operation.label: Conta dias uteis do mes sem os sabados
operation.search: $rsF032 = db_query($sSqlF032 = "SELECT count(distinct datas_mes) as F032 FROM (SELECT (ano_competencia||'-'||lpad(mes_competencia, 2, '0')||'-'||lpad(generate_series(1, ndias(ano_competencia, mes_competencia))::varchar, 2, '0'))::date AS datas_mes FROM (SELECT {$iAno} AS ano_competencia, {$iMes} AS mes_competencia ) AS competencia ) as datas_do_mes WHERE datas_mes NOT IN ( SELECT r62_data FROM calendf WHERE r62_calend = (SELECT rh53_calend FROM rhcadcalend INNER JOIN rhlotacalend ON rh64_calend = rh53_calend WHERE rh53_instit = {$iInstituicao} AND rh64_lota = {$oServidor->getCodigoLotacao()} ) AND extract('year' from r62_data) = {$iAno} AND extract('month' from r62_data) = {$iMes} )");
operation.add:
$rsF032 = db_query($sSqlF032 = " WITH dados_competencia AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN {$iMes} = 12 THEN {$iAno} + 1 ELSE {$iAno} END AS ano_competencia, CASE WHEN {$iMes} = 12 THEN 1 ELSE {$iMes} + 1 END AS mes_competencia ),
dias_trabalhados AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r63_dia FROM vtfdias WHERE r63_regist = {$iMatricula} AND r63_anousu = (SELECT ano_competencia FROM dados_competencia) AND r63_mesusu = (SELECT mes_competencia FROM dados_competencia) ),
dias_por_semana AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM r63_dia) AS semana, COUNT(DISTINCT r63_dia) AS dias_trabalhados FROM vtfdias WHERE r63_regist = {$iMatricula} AND r63_anousu = (SELECT ano_competencia FROM dados_competencia) AND r63_mesusu = (SELECT mes_competencia FROM dados_competencia) GROUP BY semana ),
feriados AS ( SELECT r62_data FROM calendf WHERE r62_calend = ( SELECT rh53_calend FROM rhcadcalend INNER JOIN rhlotacalend ON rh64_calend = rh53_calend WHERE rh64_lota = {$oServidor->getCodigoLotacao()} ) AND EXTRACT('year' FROM r62_data) = (SELECT ano_competencia FROM dados_competencia) AND EXTRACT('month' FROM r62_data) = (SELECT mes_competencia FROM dados_competencia) )
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dias_por_semana WHERE dias_trabalhados >= 5) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dias_trabalhados) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dias_trabalhados WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM r63_dia) NOT IN (0, 6) AND r63_dia NOT IN (SELECT r62_data FROM feriados)) END AS F032");
